newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca Inc in deal with Pharmacopeia.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca Inc in deal with Pharmacopeia.

text.p: Zeneca Inc, a wholly-owned subsidiary of British pharmaceutical company Zeneca Group Plc, said on Wednesday it signed a three-year collaboration agreement with U.S. group Pharmacopeia Inc.
Under the deal Pharmacopeia will design, synthesise and provide new discovery libraries of compounds for screening in a wide range of Zeneca's internal assays, Zeneca Inc said.
Pharmacopeia's discovery libraries will be licensed to Zeneca, which will receive exclusive commercial rights to any compounds it discovers using the libraries.
Zeneca said the tie-up, operated by its Zeneca Pharmaceuticals unit, was expected to boost productivity and the speed it discovered new drug candidates.
Zeneca declined to comment on the cost of the agreement.

"We are enthusiastic about our collaboration...because it will provide us with the best possible access to large combinatorial chemistry libraries from which we will be able to identify new leads for drug discovery," Andrew Shaw, vice president of lead discovery at Zeneca Pharmaceuticals, said.
